map.类似 UUencode，但使用 +-/0-9A-Za-z 字符集，可避免特殊字符: Similar to UUencode but uses the +-/0-9A-Za-z character set, avoiding special-character issues.
map.：与 UUencode 同类的历史编码，字符集不同但思路一致。: : a historical encoding like UUencode, differing only in character set.

map.：每 3 字节分为 4 个 6 位组，每组映射到字符集中的一个字符。: : every 3 bytes are split into 4 six-bit groups, each mapped to a character in the set.

map.字符集与行格式不同，编后体积相近。: Different character set and line format; similar encoded size.
map.日常几乎用不到——Base64 已成为事实标准，MIME 邮件与 HTTP 都用: Almost never in daily life — Base64 is the de facto standard, used by MIME email and HTTP. You only meet it when handling historical archives (early Usenet, old email backups) or maintaining legacy systems. Knowing it exists and the character-set difference suffices; use Base64 for all new projects.
